newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa sets share redemption price.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa sets share redemption price.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa said on Wednesday that it set its share redemption price at 152.23 crowns per share.
Trygg-Hansa AB offered a two billion crown share redemption between February 6 and March 11 and said that the redemption price was an average of the share's market value during that period.
After redeeming 13 million B-shares, a total of two million A-shares and 67.5 million B-shares remained, it said in a statement.

Trygg-Hansa Life now held 23.7 percent of equity and 39.4 percent of votes, pension-insurer SPP owned 12.3 percent of equity and 9.8 percent of votes and others held a combined 64 percent of equity and about 50.8 percent of votes, it added. -- Steve Weizman, Stockholm newsroom +46 8 7001003
